ordered_no_return_gates.name: binding_source_identity_formula_implementation_and_verification
ordered_no_return_gates.rule: Before decoding any historical source value, freeze and test the pure formula and source identity verifier. Recompute the 5451-file byte identity, price-basis manifest, calendar, universe, exact five-column projection, calendar-adjacent join, source identity, formula, zero/missing rules and output digest before publication.

ordered_no_return_gates.name: structural_coverage_variation_and_capacity_before_comparator_values
ordered_no_return_gates.rule: On the immutable quality/current-listing base require median daily coverage >=0.95, P05 daily coverage >=0.90, P05 eligible names >=50, at least 200 non-overlapping three-signal-session cohorts, at least five observed years, all candidate values finite and nonnegative, and at least 200 nonconstant cross-sectional sessions. Exact zeros remain valid. Failure stops before comparator, OHLCV or forward-return values.

ordered_no_return_gates.name: all_140_numeric_uniqueness_after_coverage_only
ordered_no_return_gates.rule: Compare in exact v162 numeric order with all 140 eligible numeric comparators. Each comparison requires at least 50 paired names per session and at least 100 qualifying sessions. Every absolute median daily average-tie Spearman correlation must be strictly below 0.8; insufficient overlap fails closed and no comparator may be removed.

source_snapshot_contract.source_identity_digest_rule: SHA256 of compact JSON [[basename,size_bytes,sha256_bytes],...] in lexicographic basename order

supersedes_protocol_v1_without_rewriting.only_change: freeze output signal dates 2019-01-01 through 2025-12-31 and allow exactly one predecessor calendar session before the start
